title: Hospital bed occupancy: the 63.5% average, and how leaders beat it
takeaways: 63.5% occupancy for ICRA's 11 listed hospital companies in FY26
77% average occupancy at Max Healthcare in Q2 FY27
Apollo occupancy up to 73% from 69% a year earlier
ARPOB rose 9.2% in FY26; 6–8% more expected in FY27
Apollo average stay cut to 3.07 days from 3.14
source_note: Sources: ICRA 2026; Business Standard; company Q2 FY27 results
